verdict.rationale: Synctera documents dedicated KYC/KYB verification objects for both personal and business customers, watchlist and identity checks, PROSPECT-to-active application state modeling, document verification, enhanced due diligence for high-risk cases, and sandbox test cases covering multiple verification flows — all programmatically accessible via API with OpenAPI spec confirmed. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and document collection specifics (e.g., upload endpoints) are only lightly referenced.
